productDecision.name: SONARA Studio
productDecision.publicBrandRule: Keep SONARA Industries, SONARA One, Business Builder, Creator Studio, and Growth Studio as the public product architecture.
productDecision.purpose: Unify creation, editing, review, rights, publishing, analytics, and governed agent workflows without turning the web process into a full desktop DAW, NLE, CAD suite, game engine, or unrestricted autonomous agent runtime.

rules: Research presence never grants execution authority.

Every runtime capability must have a feature flag, tenant boundary, idempotency contract, bounded retries, dead-letter handling, observability, rollback, and explicit approval boundary before activation.
Media generation and transformation require rights/provenance metadata; voice and likeness operations require explicit consent.
Customer-impacting publishing, campaigns, payments, refunds, payouts, destructive actions, policy changes, and security-setting changes require explicit approval.
External repositories and model weights require exact upstream, license, commercial-use, security, provenance, and version review before adoption.
Heavy media, 3D, model, OCR, transcription, CAD, and rendering workloads stay outside the public web process.

capabilities.purpose: Canonical project records linking scripts, assets, timelines, versions, rights, exports, campaigns, products, and analytics.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Organization-scoped records with RLS and immutable evidence links.

capabilities.purpose: Private asset ingestion, tagging, deduplication, provenance, checksums, versions, retention, and archive management.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Private-by-default storage; tenant-scoped object paths; no public provider URLs as durable assets.

capabilities.purpose: Scripts, captions, show notes, books, articles, shot lists, briefs, lyrics, metadata, translations, and structured revisions.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Versioned edits, source attribution, explicit publish approval.

capabilities.purpose: Text-based audio/video editing with timestamp-aligned transcript segments and reversible edits.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Original media remains immutable; edits produce a reversible edit decision list.

capabilities.purpose: Non-destructive clip sequencing, trims, transitions, captions, overlays, B-roll references, and export recipes.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Browser timeline edits metadata; heavy transcode/render work executes in an isolated worker.

capabilities.purpose: Multitrack recording plans, cleanup, transcript sync, music/SFX placement, episode packaging, chapters, show notes, and export.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: No hidden recording; consent and visible capture state required; bounded media processing.

capabilities.purpose: Narration, speech generation, voice conversion, dubbing, and accessibility workflows through approved adapters.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Active consent record required for cloning or conversion; no impersonation or unconsented likeness use.

capabilities.purpose: Music generation, sound effects, stem analysis, tempo/key/structure intelligence, mastering prep, and release packaging.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Commercial-use and model-weight licenses reviewed per engine; artist imitation and unauthorized reference copying blocked.

capabilities.purpose: Image generation/editing adapters, campaign graphics, product imagery, thumbnails, cover art, and brand templates.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Rights/provenance and brand-template constraints required before export or publication.

capabilities.purpose: Text/image-to-video, B-roll, concept scenes, product footage, cinematic drafts, and model-routed generation.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Consent and rights attestation; provider budgets; no unapproved public-figure or protected-work imitation.

capabilities.purpose: Timestamped comments, approval states, compare versions, client review links, and evidence-backed signoff.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Signed/expiring links, scoped permissions, immutable approval events.

capabilities.purpose: WebRTC audio/video review, screen sharing, co-review, and live creative sessions.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Explicit session consent; no covert capture; provider-backed TURN/SFU where required.

capabilities.purpose: Deterministic export recipes for aspect ratio, resolution, captions, thumbnails, audio loudness targets, file naming, and package assembly.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Idempotent exports, resource quotas, reproducible settings, checksum and provenance recording.

capabilities.purpose: Provider adapters for user-authorized social upload/posting with platform-specific metadata and status tracking.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Per-provider OAuth, explicit consent, platform audit/terms compliance, approval before customer-impacting post.

capabilities.purpose: Unify asset, post, campaign, audience, conversion, retention, and revenue performance with source-aware metrics.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Source and timestamp on every metric; no fabricated engagement or attribution.

capabilities.purpose: Track ownership, license, consent, source asset, provider/model, prompt, transformation chain, and export provenance.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Fail closed when required ownership, consent, or license evidence is missing.

capabilities.purpose: Compose bounded skills, deterministic steps, agent reasoning, approvals, tools, retries, and evidence into reusable workflows.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Explicit tool allowlists, delegated authority, approval checkpoints, budget limits, stop controls, trace IDs, and audit events.

capabilities.purpose: Recoverable long-running generation, publishing, rendering, import/export, and agent workflows.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Idempotency, retries/backoff, dead letters, cancellation, timeout, concurrency control, and rollback required.

capabilities.purpose: Source-cited retrieval over organization documents, projects, transcripts, media metadata, policies, customer records, and approved external sources.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Tenant-filter before retrieval, source citations, ACL-aware chunks, hybrid retrieval, freshness, and no cross-tenant vector leakage.

capabilities.purpose: Browser previews for approved 3D assets, product scenes, spatial layouts, lightweight AR concepts, and interactive presentations.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Progressive enhancement and fallback required; WebGPU is optional and not assumed available.

capabilities.purpose: Round-trip jobs and asset handoff to Blender/Unreal/Autodesk-class tools instead of recreating a full DCC/CAD/game engine in-browser.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Signed project exchange, no arbitrary local shell authority, explicit user-controlled import/export.

capabilities.purpose: Game design documents, asset pipelines, narrative, QA/test plans, telemetry schemas, build/release checklists, and engine companion workflows.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: SONARA orchestrates projects and assets; engine-specific builds stay in approved external engines.

capabilities.purpose: Data setup, workflows, forms, KPIs, templates, integrations, and agent skills for restaurants, trades, trucking, retail, construction, manufacturing, cleaning, professional services, real estate, creators, and other verticals.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: Each pack must use shared identity, billing, permissions, audit, records, and approval systems instead of creating a separate OS.

capabilities.purpose: Research-only pathways for banking, insurance, government, public-sector, critical infrastructure, military/defense-adjacent administration, and high-risk decision support.
capabilities.safetyBoundary: No autonomous high-impact decisions; legal/compliance/security review and domain-specific controls required before any customer runtime.

technologyPatterns.name: OpenFeature
technologyPatterns.role: Vendor-neutral feature flag API for staged rollout, canaries, kill switches, and degraded-mode control.
technologyPatterns.adoptionNote: Already present in package dependencies; prefer canonical use over a second feature-flag framework.

technologyPatterns.name: OpenTelemetry
technologyPatterns.role: Standard traces, metrics, logs, and correlation across requests, agents, jobs, providers, and background workers.
technologyPatterns.adoptionNote: Already present in package dependencies; standardize correlation across web, agents, providers, and workers.

technologyPatterns.name: Temporal-style durable execution
technologyPatterns.role: Reference architecture for long-running recoverable workflows, signals, timers, retries, and human-in-the-loop suspension.
technologyPatterns.adoptionNote: Benchmark against existing SONARA event-consumer capabilities before adding a service or dependency.

technologyPatterns.name: MCP 2026-07-28
technologyPatterns.role: Stateless tool/context interoperability reference for governed connectors and agent tools.

technologyPatterns.name: pgvector
technologyPatterns.role: Postgres-native embeddings and hybrid retrieval for tenant-scoped RAG.
technologyPatterns.adoptionNote: Fits existing Postgres/Supabase path; tenant filtering and retrieval evaluation remain mandatory.

technologyPatterns.name: OpenFGA / OPA patterns
technologyPatterns.role: Fine-grained relationship/context authorization references for agent delegation, shared projects, review links, and complex organization roles.
technologyPatterns.adoptionNote: Authorization references only until an ADR proves why existing RLS/role controls are insufficient.

technologyPatterns.name: FFmpeg
technologyPatterns.role: Media transcode, probe, packaging, waveform, thumbnail, and deterministic export worker.
technologyPatterns.licensePosture: LGPL-2.1+ default with optional GPL components
technologyPatterns.adoptionNote: Use only in an isolated worker with a reviewed build/configuration and distribution posture.

technologyPatterns.name: Blender 5.2 LTS
technologyPatterns.adoptionNote: External/owner-device companion; do not embed Blender source into SONARA proprietary web runtime.
